reply.text: At 13, you're still growing, and "fast abs" isn't really a thing anyone can promise — ab definition is mostly about body fat, which isn't something I'd coach a 13-year-old to chase hard. What I can help with: solid core work (planks, dead bugs, hanging knee raises), eating enough protein and whole food to support growth, and sleep. If you want, tell me what you've got for equipment and we can build you a simple core routine to add to your training.
